id: \rThere are ruins nearby.

id: \rI want to explore them one day. It sounds fun.

id: \rLillie: W-Who's there?

en: \rLillie: \PN. I'm sorry. I couldn't see you in the snowstorm. But what are you doing here?
it: \rLylia: \PN. Scusami. Non ti vedevo nella tormenta. Ma cosa ci fai qui?

id: \rYou're looking for a strange Pokémon. Come inside. I think I know what you're talking about.
en: \rYou're looking for a strange Pokémon. Come inside. I think I know what you're talking about.

id: \rDon't you love the way the air stings your face?

id: \rThis place is a breath of fresh air.

id: \rI lost something around here. Have you seen it?

it: \rHo perso una cosa da queste parti. L'hai vista?

id: \bIt's a great day for a hike.

id: \bGreat battle. I'm going to get back to my walk.

it: \bOttima lotta. Ora torno alla mia passeggiata.

id: \rAre you trying to get back to town?

it: \rStai cercando di tornare in paese?

id: \rHead left from here. Freezington is close.
en: \rHead left from here. Freezington is close.

id: \bAre you hurt? No? Then time for a battle.
en: \bAre you hurt? No? Then time for a battle.
it: \bTi sei fatto male? No? Allora è ora di lottare.

id: \bThat was fun. Come back if you get hurt.
en: \bThat was fun. Come back if you get hurt.

id: \rI think it's somewhere nearby.

it: \rCredo che sia da qualche parte qui vicino.

id: \bAren't you cold?
en: \bAren't you cold?
it: \bNon hai freddo?

id: \bIt's cold. Be sure to keep moving.
en: \bIt's cold. Be sure to keep moving.

id: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.

it: \bOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!
